name: The Call Boards offer Season 10's board quests up to level 60 and pay their Runes of Ascension
contract: Darkmoon - Season 10 Wildcard's quest cache holds the Call Board quests of that realm. Those up to level 60 whose targets are spawned and whose items have a source here are on the Hero's Call Board (402000) and the Warchief's Command Board (402001): profession orders such as Making Ends Meat: Coyote Steak (1005646, 1500 Runes of Ascension) and True Artisan: A Bunch of Bars (1005689), PvE quests such as Gorilla Warfare (18065) and Hero's Call: Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj (77877), and City Siege: Battle for Thunder Bluff (81255) for the Alliance only. The wiki's Call Board page says the board shows every quest a max-level Hero can take; when a category exceeds the 32-entry menu limit, the quests with the highest minimum level stay listed. Turning an order in pays its runes.
